title: Service Contracts: commitment band, term, effective date, rate basis and lane of an offer
content:
## Scope
This policy of the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product applies when a contract offer is issued. It sets the conditions the offer itself must meet on the commitment, the term, the effective date, the rate basis and the trade lane.

## Formal clause
An offer is written in the tier whose band contains the commitment: the minimum quantity commitment must lie between the tier's lowest and highest commitment, both figures included. The term, running from the effective date to the expiry date, must last at least the tier's shortest term and at most its longest term. The effective date may lie no more than the tier's latest-effective-date figure, in calendar days, after the offer date. The rate basis must be one of the rate bases the tier allows, and the trade lane one of the lanes on which the tier may be written.

## Checklist
| Item on the offer | Compared with | Met when |
|---|---|---|
| Commitment (FEU) | the tier's lowest and highest commitment | it is not below the lowest and not above the highest |
| Term from effective date to expiry date | the tier's shortest and longest term (months) | it is not shorter than the shortest and not longer than the longest |
| Effective date | the offer date and the tier's latest-effective-date figure | it is no more than that many calendar days after the offer date |
| Rate basis | the tier's allowed rate bases | it is one of them |
| Trade lane | the tier's allowed lanes | it is one of them |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical figures)
- **Commitment on the edge of a band.** A commitment exactly equal to the tier's lowest or highest figure lies inside the band, because both ends are included.
- **Effective date.** Assume an offer dated 2026-05-20 in a tier whose latest-effective-date figure were 40 days. The latest effective date is then 2026-06-29. An effective date of 2026-06-29 is 40 days after the offer and meets the clause; 2026-06-30 is 41 days after and does not.
- **Rate basis.** An index-linked offer in a tier that allows the fixed rate basis only does not meet the clause, whatever the commitment.

## Point of judgement
**The commitment fits one tier's band, but the customer asks for another tier's name.** The tier of the offer is the one whose band contains the commitment; the band, not the requested name, decides the tier.
